![Eagle Offensive Platform](docs/images/eagle-hero.svg) # Eagle Offensive Platform **Next-generation endpoint protection** — NGAV + lightweight EDR for malware, ransomware, fileless attacks, and modern threats. [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.11+-3776AB?style=for-the-badge&logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org/) [![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-Endpoint-0078D4?style=for-the-badge&logo=windows&logoColor=white)](https://www.microsoft.com/windows) [![YAML](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rules-YAML-CB171E?style=for-the-badge&logo=yaml&logoColor=white)](agent/config/rules.yaml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Proprietary-red?style=for-the-badge)](#license) [Quick Start](#-quick-start) · [Tree of Knowledge](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=eagle-offensive-platform) · [Architecture](#-architecture) · [Detection Pipeline](#-detection-pipeline) · [Console](#-local-web-console) · [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md)
--- ## About **Eagle Offensive Platform** (EOP) is a defensive endpoint-security prototype built for **precision, speed, and operational efficiency**. It combines behavioral detection, declarative YAML rules, memory heuristics, and a local operator console — all focused on **protecting Windows hosts**, not offensive tooling. | Pillar | Description | |--------|-------------| | **NGAV** | Hash/reputation + process/path rules | | **Behavioral EDR** | Parent→child chains, LOLBins, ransomware precursors | | **Memory heuristics** | Safe metadata-based suspicious process tagging | | **Local console** | Live alerts, coverage map, scan & monitor controls | | **Cloud-ready design** | Telemetry JSONL, policy pull, isolate (Phase 2+) | > **Scope:** Defensive endpoint protection only. No exploits, malware payloads, or offensive modules. --- ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - Windows 10/11 (MVP target) - Python 3.11+ - PowerShell ### Install & run console ```powershell git clone https://github.com/CanonEngineer/EagleOffensivePlatform.git cd EagleOffensivePlatform\agent python -m venv .venv .\.venv\Scripts\activate pip install -r requirements.txt python -m eagle console ``` Opens **`http://127.0.0.1:8787`** — live alerts, filters, rules, scan, and local monitor. **Does not** install a Windows Service. ### CLI commands ```powershell python -m eagle scan --once # Single detection pass python -m eagle scan # Continuous monitor (Ctrl+C to stop) python -m eagle scan --enforce # Apply kill/quarantine (lab only!) python -m eagle alerts # Show recent alerts python -m eagle quarantine # List quarantined files python -m eagle console --port 8787 # Web console ``` --- ## Tree of Knowledge Full **2D tree** and **Galaxy 3D** code map on the CanonEngineer knowledge hub: **[Eagle Offensive Platform on Tree of Knowledge](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=eagle-offensive-platform)** · [Full hub](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/) Every source file is mapped as an interactive node — hover for description, click for embedded code and implementation steps. --- ## Architecture ![Logical architecture](docs/images/architecture.svg) ### C4 — Container view ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Operator CLI[CLI python -m eagle] WEB[Web Console :8787] end subgraph Agent["Eagle Agent (Windows)"] SEN[Sensor psutil] COR[Correlator] MEM[Memory Scan] ENG[RuleEngine YAML] RES[Responder] RUN[AgentRunner] end subgraph Storage RULES[(rules.yaml)] COV[(coverage.yaml)] LOGS[(alerts.jsonl · telemetry.jsonl)] QUAR[(quarantine/)] end CLI --> RUN WEB --> RUN RUN --> SEN --> COR --> MEM --> ENG --> RES ENG --> RULES RUN --> LOGS RES --> QUAR WEB --> COV ``` ### Component responsibilities | Module | File | Role | |--------|------|------| | **Sensor** | `agent/eagle/sensor.py` | Process telemetry via `psutil` polling | | **Correlator** | `agent/eagle/correlator.py` | Behavioral tags (`mass_file_write`, `office_child_shell`) | | **RuleEngine** | `agent/eagle/engine.py` | YAML declarative match → `Alert` | | **MemoryScan** | `agent/eagle/memory_scan.py` | Safe heuristics (no invasive reads) | | **Responder** | `agent/eagle/response.py` | Log, kill, quarantine (enforce mode) | | **AgentRunner** | `agent/eagle/runner.py` | Orchestration loop (CLI, console, service) | | **ConsoleServer** | `agent/eagle/console_server.py` | HTTP API + static UI | | **Coverage** | `agent/eagle/coverage.py` | MITRE/SIEM scope reporting | --- ## Detection Pipeline ![Detection pipeline](docs/images/detection-pipeline.svg) ```mermaid flowchart LR A[psutil process_iter] --> B[ProcessEvent] B --> C{New/updated PID?} C -->|yes| D[Correlator.enrich] D --> E[annotate_memory_hints] E --> F[RuleEngine.evaluate] F --> G{Match?} G -->|yes| H[Alert] H --> I[Responder.handle] I --> J[alerts.jsonl] I --> K{enforce?} K -->|yes| L[kill / quarantine] B --> M[telemetry.jsonl] ``` ### Rule match dimensions Rules in `agent/config/rules.yaml` support: - `process_name_in` / `process_name_not_in` - `parent_name_in` / `parent_name_not_in` - `cmdline_contains_any` / `cmdline_contains_all` - `path_contains_any` / `path_not_contains_any` - `process_name_endswith` - `tags_any` (from correlator/memory) ### Severity & actions | Severity | Typical use | |----------|-------------| | `info` | Inventory / audit | | `low` | Suspicious but common | | `medium` | LOLBin abuse | | `high` | Ransomware precursors, C2 | | `critical` | Active compromise indicators | | Action | Behavior | |--------|----------| | `monitor` | Telemetry only | | `alert` | Log to `alerts.jsonl` | | `kill` | Terminate process (enforce) | | `quarantine` | Kill + move executable (enforce) | --- ## Local Web Console ![Console flow](docs/images/console-flow.svg) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Op as Operator participant UI as console/static participant API as ConsoleServer participant Run as AgentRunner Op->>UI: Open :8787 UI->>API: GET /api/health Op->>UI: Start monitor UI->>API: POST /api/monitor/start API->>Run: Background thread loop Every interval Run->>Run: pass_once() Run-->>API: alerts.jsonl end Op->>UI: View alerts UI->>API: GET /api/alerts API-->>UI: JSON alert list ``` ### API reference | Endpoint | Method | Description | |----------|--------|-------------| | `/api/health` | GET | Service health | | `/api/stats` | GET | Alert counts, rules, quarantine | | `/api/alerts` | GET | Recent alerts (`?limit=200`) | | `/api/coverage` | GET | MITRE/SIEM coverage map | | `/api/rules` | GET | Loaded detection rules | | `/api/quarantine` | GET | Quarantined files | | `/api/audit` | GET | Recent telemetry lines | | `/api/scan` | POST | Single scan pass | | `/api/monitor/start` | POST | Background monitor | | `/api/monitor/stop` | POST | Stop monitor | --- ## Repository structure ``` EagleOffensivePlatform/ ├── agent/ │ ├── eagle/ # Core Python package │ │ ├── sensor.py # Process telemetry │ │ ├── correlator.py # Behavioral enrichment │ │ ├── engine.py # YAML rule engine │ │ ├── memory_scan.py # Memory heuristics │ │ ├── response.py # Alert response │ │ ├── runner.py # Main loop │ │ ├── console_server.py # Web console backend │ │ ├── cli.py # CLI entrypoints │ │ └── service.py # Windows Service (lab) │ ├── config/ │ │ ├── rules.yaml # Detection rules │ │ └── coverage.yaml # Coverage catalog │ ├── console/static/ # Web UI (HTML/CSS/JS) │ └── scripts/ # Service install PS1 ├── docs/ │ ├── ARCHITECTURE.md # Full architecture doc │ ├── ROADMAP.md # 30/60/90 day plan │ ├── MONITORING_SCOPE.md # Detection scope │ └── images/ # Engineering diagrams └── landing/ # Product pitch page ``` --- ## Threat coverage (MVP) ```mermaid mindmap root((Eagle EOP)) Malware Hash rules Suspicious paths Ransomware Mass file write tag Shadow delete patterns Fileless PowerShell -enc WMI abuse LOLBins certutil mshta rundll32 msbuild regsvr32 Exploit chains Office to shell Browser to cmd Memory Hollowed process hints Missing exe path ``` See [`docs/MONITORING_SCOPE.md`](docs/MONITORING_SCOPE.md) for the full coverage matrix. --- ## Windows Service (lab only) ```powershell # Isolated lab VM ONLY — never on production hosts python -m eagle service-info .\scripts\install_service.ps1 ``` The service wrapper uses `pywin32` and shares `AgentRunner` with the CLI and console. --- ## Development ```powershell cd agent python -m venv .venv .\.venv\Scripts\activate pip install -r requirements.txt # Run tests manually python -m eagle scan --once --all python -m eagle console --no-browser ``` ### Design principles 1. **Defense in depth** — prevention + detection + response 2. **Decide locally** — block with minimal latency; cloud enriches later 3. **Least privilege API** — narrow console surface, localhost bind 4. **Full observability** — every verdict is JSONL-auditable 5. **Windows-first MVP** — Linux/macOS in later phases --- ## Roadmap | Phase | Timeline | Deliverables | |-------|----------|--------------| | **MVP** | 0–30 days | Sensor, rules, console, JSONL logs | | **Hardening** | 30–60 days | ETW hooks, anti-tamper basics | | **Cloud** | 60–90 days | Policy sync, cross-host correlation, ML scoring | Full plan: [`docs/ROADMAP.md`](docs/ROADMAP.md) --- ## # Eagle Agent — protótipo Windows

Sensor + motor de regras locais + resposta (monitor / alert / kill / quarantine).

## Requisitos

- Python 3.10+
- Windows (recomendado); funciona em modo limitado em outros OS

```powershell
cd agent
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Uso (CLI — seguro na sua máquina)

```powershell
python -m eagle scan --interval 3
python -m eagle scan --once --all
python -m eagle alerts
python -m eagle quarantine
python -m eagle service-info

# Painel interativo local (abre o browser em http://127.0.0.1:8787)
python -m eagle console
```

O console lê `logs/alerts.jsonl`, lista regras, permite **Scan agora** e **Iniciar monitor** (thread local — não é Windows Service).

## Windows Service (somente lab/VM)

O código existe em `eagle/service.py` e `scripts/`.

**Não instale no PC de trabalho.** Em VM isolada, como Admin:

```powershell
pip install pywin32
# ou
.\scripts\install_service.ps1   # pede LAB-CONFIRM
python -m eagle.service start
```

Remoção (lab):

```powershell
.\scripts\uninstall_service.ps1
```

## Estrutura

```
eagle/
  cli.py
  runner.py
  console_server.py   # API + servidor do painel
  service.py
  ...
console/static/       # Frontend interativo (HTML/CSS/JS)
config/rules.yaml
scripts/
```

## Aviso

Protótipo defensivo para laboratório. Não substitui EDR/NGAV de produção.

# Políticas locais do Eagle (MVP v1.1)
# Somente detecção defensiva — sem payloads ofensivos.

rules:
  # --- LOLBins / living-off-the-land ---
  - id: LOLBIN-CERTUTIL-DOWNLOAD
    name: Certutil download behavior
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [certutil.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["-urlcache", "-split", "http://", "https://"]

  - id: LOLBIN-CERTUTIL-DECODE
    name: Certutil decode / encode staging
    severity: medium
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [certutil.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["-decode", "-decodehex", "-encode"]

  - id: LOLBIN-BITSADMIN
    name: Bitsadmin transfer
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [bitsadmin.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["/transfer", "http://", "https://"]

  - id: LOLBIN-CURL-DOWNLOAD
    name: Curl remote download
    severity: medium
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [curl.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["http://", "https://"]

  - id: LOLBIN-MSHTA
    name: Mshta script host abuse
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [mshta.exe]

  - id: LOLBIN-RUNDLL32-JS
    name: Rundll32 javascript/mshtml
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [rundll32.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["javascript:", "mshtml", "url.dll", ".inf", "shell32.dll,shellexec_rundll"]

  - id: LOLBIN-REGSVR32-SCRIPT
    name: Regsvr32 scriplet / remote
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [regsvr32.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["/i:", "scrobj.dll", "http://", "https://"]

  - id: LOLBIN-CMSTP
    name: CMSTP inf abuse
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [cmstp.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["/s", "/au", "/ni"]

  - id: LOLBIN-HH-CHM
    name: HTML Help with shell payload hint
    severity: medium
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [hh.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: [".chm", "http://", "https://"]

  - id: LOLBIN-INSTALLUTIL
    name: InstallUtil .NET execution
    severity: medium
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [installutil.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["/logfile=", "/logfilepath=", ".dll", ".exe"]

  - id: LOLBIN-MSBUILD
    name: MSBuild inline task / custom build
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [msbuild.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: [".xml", ".csproj", ".vbproj", "http://", "https://"]

  - id: LOLBIN-CSC-COMPILE
    name: C# compiler staging
    severity: medium
    action: monitor
    match:
      process_name_in: [csc.exe]
      path_contains_any: ["\\temp\\", "\\appdata\\", "\\users\\public\\", "\\downloads\\"]

  - id: LOLBIN-MSIEXEC-REMOTE
    name: Msiexec remote / quiet install
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [msiexec.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["http://", "https://", "/q", "-q"]

  - id: LOLBIN-FORFILES
    name: Forfiles proxy execution
    severity: medium
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [forfiles.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["/c ", "-c ", "cmd ", "powershell"]

  - id: LOLBIN-ODBCCONF
    name: Odbcconf REGSVR abuse
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [odbcconf.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["regsvr", "/a ", "-a ", ".dll"]

  - id: LOLBIN-MAVINJECT
    name: Mavinject process injection helper
    severity: critical
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [mavinject.exe, mavinject64.exe]

  - id: LOLBIN-PRESENTATIONHOST
    name: PresentationHost XBAP
    severity: medium
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [presentationhost.exe]

  - id: LOLBIN-SYNCAPPVPUBLISHING
    name: SyncAppvPublishingServer script abuse
    severity: high
    action: alert
    match:
      process_name_in: [syncappvpublishingserver.exe]
      cmdline_contains_any: ["n; ", "javascript:", "http"]

  - id: LOLBIN-WSCRIPT-EXE-EXT
    name: WScript running unexpected extension
    severity: medium
    action: alert

import argparse
import json
import sys

from eagle.runner import AgentRunner, default_paths


def cmd_scan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = default_paths()
    runner = AgentRunner(
        paths=paths,
        interval=args.interval,
        enforce=args.enforce,
        evaluate_all=args.all,
    )

    print(f"Eagle agent v0.1 — mode={'enforce' if args.enforce else 'monitor'}")
    print(f"Rules: {paths.rules}")
    if not args.once:
        print("Ctrl+C to stop.\n")

    if args.once:
        n = runner.pass_once()
        print(f"Done. alerts={n}")
        return 0

    try:
        runner.run_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nEagle stopped.")
    return 0


def cmd_alerts(_: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = default_paths()
    if not paths.alerts.exists():
        print("No alerts yet.")
        return 0
    lines = paths.alerts.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip().splitlines()
    for line in lines[-50:]:
        try:
            data = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        print(
            f"{data.get('ts')} [{data.get('severity')}] {data.get('rule_id')} "
            f"{data.get('process', {}).get('name')} pid={data.get('process', {}).get('pid')}"
        )
    return 0


def cmd_quarantine(_: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = default_paths()
    paths.quarantine.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    files = sorted(paths.quarantine.glob("*"))
    if not files:
        print("Quarantine empty.")
        return 0
    for f in files:
        print(f.name)
    return 0


def cmd_service_info(_: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    print(
        "Windows Service code is available as: python -m eagle.service\n"
        "Install ONLY on an isolated lab VM — never on your daily work PC.\n"
        "See scripts\\install_service.ps1 (do not run on production hosts)."
    )
    return 0


def cmd_console(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from eagle.console_server import run_console

    run_console(host=args.host, port=args.port, open_browser=not args.no_browser)
    return 0


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="eagle", description="Eagle endpoint agent prototype")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    scan = sub.add_parser("scan", help="Run endpoint scan / monitor loop")
    scan.add_argument("--interval", type=float, default=3.0, help="Seconds between polls")
    scan.add_argument("--once", action="store_true", help="Single pass")
    scan.add_argument(
        "--all",
        action="store_true",
        help="Evaluate all processes each pass (not only new)",
    )
    scan.add_argument(
        "--enforce",
        action="store_true",
        help="Apply kill/quarantine actions (default: monitor only)",
    )
    scan.set_defaults(func=cmd_scan)

    alerts = sub.add_parser("alerts", help="Show recent alerts")
    alerts.set_defaults(func=cmd_alerts)

    quar = sub.add_parser("quarantine", help="List quarantined files")
    quar.set_defaults(func=cmd_quarantine)

    svc = sub.add_parser("service-info", help="How to use the Windows Service (lab only)")
    svc.set_defaults(func=cmd_service_info)

    console = sub.add_parser("console", help="Open local interactive web console")
    console.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1", help="Bind address (default localhost)")
    console.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8787, help="Port (default 8787)")
    console.add_argument(
        "--no-browser",
        action="store_true",
        help="Do not open the browser automatically",
    )
    console.set_defaults(func=cmd_console)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return int(args.func(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

from eagle.correlator import Correlator
from eagle.engine import RuleEngine
from eagle.memory_scan import annotate_memory_hints
from eagle.response import Responder
from eagle.sensor import Sensor, sleep_interval

log = logging.getLogger("eagle")


@dataclass
class RuntimePaths:
    root: Path
    rules: Path
    coverage: Path
    logs: Path
    alerts: Path
    telemetry: Path
    quarantine: Path

    @classmethod
    def from_root(cls, root: Path) -> "RuntimePaths":
        logs = root / "logs"
        return cls(
            root=root,
            rules=root / "config" / "rules.yaml",
            coverage=root / "config" / "coverage.yaml",
            logs=logs,
            alerts=logs / "alerts.jsonl",
            telemetry=logs / "telemetry.jsonl",
            quarantine=root / "quarantine",
        )


def default_paths() -> RuntimePaths:
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    return RuntimePaths.from_root(root)


class AgentRunner:
    """Loop compartilhado pela CLI, console e Windows Service (código apenas)."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        paths: RuntimePaths | None = None,
        interval: float = 3.0,
        enforce: bool = False,
        evaluate_all: bool = False,
        stop_check: Callable[[], bool] | None = None,
        quiet: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.paths = paths or default_paths()
        self.interval = interval
        self.enforce = enforce
        self.evaluate_all = evaluate_all
        self.stop_check = stop_check or (lambda: False)
        self.quiet = quiet

        self.paths.logs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.sensor = Sensor()
        self.correlator = Correlator(self.sensor)
        self.engine = RuleEngine(self.paths.rules)
        self.responder = Responder(
            self.paths.quarantine,
            self.paths.alerts,
            enforce=enforce,
        )

    def pass_once(self) -> int:
        events = self.sensor.snapshot_processes()
        fresh = events if self.evaluate_all else self.sensor.new_or_updated(events)
        fresh = self.correlator.enrich(fresh)
        fresh = annotate_memory_hints(fresh)

        alert_count = 0
        with self.paths.telemetry.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for event in fresh:
                fh.write(json.dumps(event.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                for alert in self.engine.evaluate(event):
                    alert_count += 1
                    self.responder.handle(alert)
                    msg = (
                        f"[{alert.severity.upper()}] {alert.rule_id} "
                        f"pid={alert.process.pid} {alert.process.name} -> {alert.action}"
                    )
                    log.info(msg)
                    if not self.quiet:
                        print(msg)
        return alert_count

    def run_forever(self) -> None:
        log.info(
            "Eagle runner started mode=%s interval=%s rules=%s",
            "enforce" if self.enforce else "monitor",
            self.interval,
            self.paths.rules,
        )
        while not self.stop_check():
            try:
                self.engine.reload()
                self.pass_once()
            except Exception:
                log.exception("scan pass failed")
            sleep_interval(self.interval)

"""
Windows Service nativo (pywin32) — CÓDIGO NO REPOSITÓRIO APENAS.

NÃO instale este serviço na máquina de trabalho sem decisão explícita
em ambiente de laboratório/VM isolada.

Uso (somente lab, como Administrador):

  python -m eagle.service install
  python -m eagle.service start
  python -m eagle.service stop
  python -m eagle.service remove
"""

import logging
import os
import sys
import threading
from pathlib import Path

LOG_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "logs"
LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

logging.basicConfig(
    filename=str(LOG_DIR / "service.log"),
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s",
)
log = logging.getLogger("eagle.service")

SERVICE_NAME = "EagleEndpointAgent"
SERVICE_DISPLAY = "Eagle Endpoint Protection Agent"
SERVICE_DESC = "Prototype defensive endpoint agent (monitor mode). Lab use only."


def _load_pywin32():
    try:
        import servicemanager
        import win32event
        import win32service
        import win32serviceutil
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(
            "pywin32 is required for the Windows Service wrapper.\n"
            "  pip install pywin32\n"
            "Do NOT install the service on a production/work machine without approval."
        ) from exc
    return win32event, win32service, win32serviceutil, servicemanager


def _service_class():
    win32event, win32service, win32serviceutil, servicemanager = _load_pywin32()

    class EagleService(win32serviceutil.ServiceFramework):
        _svc_name_ = SERVICE_NAME
        _svc_display_name_ = SERVICE_DISPLAY
        _svc_description_ = SERVICE_DESC

        def __init__(self, args):
            win32serviceutil.ServiceFramework.__init__(self, args)
            self.stop_event = win32event.CreateEvent(None, 0, 0, None)
            self._stop = threading.Event()

        def SvcStop(self):
            self.ReportServiceStatus(win32service.SERVICE_STOP_PENDING)
            self._stop.set()
            win32event.SetEvent(self.stop_event)
            log.info("stop requested")

        def SvcDoRun(self):
            servicemanager.LogMsg(
                servicemanager.EVENTLOG_INFORMATION_TYPE,
                servicemanager.PYS_SERVICE_STARTED,
                (self._svc_name_, ""),
            )
            self.main()

        def main(self):
            from eagle.runner import AgentRunner

            interval = float(os.environ.get("EAGLE_INTERVAL", "3"))
            enforce = os.environ.get("EAGLE_ENFORCE", "0") == "1"

            runner = AgentRunner(
                interval=interval,
                enforce=enforce,
                evaluate_all=False,
                stop_check=self._stop.is_set,
            )
            log.info("service loop starting enforce=%s", enforce)
            try:
                runner.run_forever()
            except Exception:
                log.exception("service crashed")
                raise

    return EagleService, win32serviceutil


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    argv = list(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv)

    if len(argv) <= 1:
        print(
            "Eagle Windows Service helper (lab only).\n"
            f"  Service name: {SERVICE_NAME}\n\n"
            "Commands: install | remove | start | stop | restart | debug\n"
            "WARNING: Do not install on your daily work machine.\n"
            "         Use an isolated lab VM."
        )
        return 0

    cmd = argv[1].lower()
    if cmd in {"install", "remove", "start", "stop", "restart", "update", "debug"}:
        EagleService, win32serviceutil = _service_class()
        sys.argv = [argv[0], *argv[1:]]
        win32serviceutil.HandleCommandLine(EagleService)
        return 0

    print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Eagle — Arquitetura do módulo de proteção de endpoint

## 1. Visão

**Eagle** é um módulo de proteção de endpoint de nova geração (NGAV + EDR leve), voltado à prevenção de malwares, ransomware, ataques sem arquivo e ameaças modernas.

Pilares:

| Pilar | Descrição |
|-------|-----------|
| Inteligência artificial | Classificação local e em nuvem de comportamentos e artefatos |
| Inteligência de ameaças | IOCs, TTPs, reputação e feeds atualizados |
| Análise comportamental | Detecção por cadeia de eventos (processo, arquivo, rede, registro) |
| Varredura de memória | Inspeção de processos, injeções e regiões suspeitas |
| Mitigação de exploits | Hardening e bloqueio de técnicas de exploração |

## 2. Princípios de desenho

1. **Defesa em profundidade** — prevenção no endpoint + detecção + resposta.
2. **Decide localmente, aprimora na nuvem** — bloqueio com latência mínima; telemetria enriquece o modelo.
3. **Menor privilégio operacional** — o agente precisa de direitos elevados; a superfície de API é estreita.
4. **Observabilidade** — todo veredito (allow / block / quarantine) é auditável.
5. **Foco Windows no MVP** — Linux/macOS em fases posteriores.

## 3. Arquitetura lógica

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     CONSOLE / CLOUD                          │
│  Policies · Alertas · Threat Intel · Modelos · Hunting       │
└──────────────────────────▲──────────────────────────────────┘
                           │ telemetria + vereditos
                           │ policies / IOCs / modelos
┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐
│                    AGENTE ENDPOINT (Windows)                  │
│  ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐│
│  │ Sensor   │→│ Pipeline │→│ Motor    │→│ Resposta         ││
│  │ eventos  │ │ correlação│ │ NGAV/EDR │ │ kill/quarantine  ││
│  └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────────────┘│
│       ↑              ↑             ↑                         │
│   processo      comportamento   memória / exploits           │
│   arquivo rede  regras locais   scan periódico               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 4. Componentes do agente

### 4.1 Sensor

Captura eventos de sistema (MVP em polling; produção: ETW / kernel callbacks / minifilter):

- Criação/terminação de processos e linhagem (parent → child)
- Escrita/execução de arquivos
- Conexões de rede de saída
- Alterações sensíveis de registro (Run keys, services)
- Carregamento de módulos (DLL)

### 4.2 Pipeline de correlação

Monta **cadeias comportamentais** a curto prazo, por exemplo:

- `winword.exe` → `cmd.exe` → `powershell.exe -enc ...`
- Massa de renomeações de arquivo + nota de resgate → **ransomware**
- Processo sem imagem em disco + alocação RX → **fileless / inject**

### 4.3 Motor de detecção

Camadas (ordem aproximada):

1. **Reputação / hash** — allow/block list e TI
2. **Regras comportamentais** — políticas declarativas (JSON/YAML)
3. **Heurísticas de memória** — regiões executáveis anômalas, hollowed processes
4. **Modelo ML local (fase 2)** — score de risco sem depender da nuvem
5. **Mitigações de exploit** — políticas de process hardening (fase 2+)

Severidades: `info` | `low` | `medium` | `high` | `critical`

Ações: `monitor` | `alert` | `block` | `kill` | `quarantine` | `isolate` (isolate = fase cloud)

### 4.4 Resposta

- Encerrar processo ofensor
- Quarentena de arquivo (mover + ACL restritiva)
- Bloquear execução futura do hash
- Registrar evidência (JSONL) para investigação

### 4.5 Comunicação cloud (fase 2+)

- Envio de telemetria assinada (TLS)
- Pull de policies, IOCs e modelos
- Isolamento de host via console

## 5. Backend (fase cloud)

| Serviço | Responsabilidade |
|---------|------------------|
| Ingestão | Recebe eventos/vereditos do agente |
| Policy service | Versões de políticas por tenant/grupo |
| Threat intel | IOCs, campanhas, mapeamento MITRE ATT&CK |
| Detection | Regras correlacionadas cross-host |
| Console API | Alertas, hunt, remediação remota |
| Model registry | Empacota e versiona modelos ML |

## 6. Modelo de ameaças coberto (MVP)

| Ameaça | Abordagem MVP |
|-------|----------------|
| Malware clássico | Hash + regras de processo/caminho suspeito |
| Ransomware | Comportamento (criptografia em massa, shadow delete) |
| Fileless | PowerShell encoded, WMI, LOLBins em cadeia |
| Living-off-the-land | Regras para `certutil`, `mshta`, `rundll32`, etc. |
| Exploit → payload | Linhagem anômala pós-aplicação (Office → shell) |
| Memória | Scan periódico de indicadores simples no protótipo |

## 7. Dados e privacidade

- Telemetria mínima necessária para detecção
- Hashes e metadados preferidos a conteúdo completo de arquivo
- Retenção configurável no cloud
- Logs locais rotacionados (`logs/`)

## 8. Segurança do próprio agente

- Execução como serviço com integridade de binário (fase produção)
- Assinatura de policies e atualizações
- Proteção anti-tamper básica (fase 2+)
- Sem coleta ofensiva; superfície apenas defensiva

## 9. Mapa para o repositório

| Caminho | Papel |
|---------|--------|
| `agent/` | Protótipo do sensor + motor + resposta |
| `landing/` | Pitch / página do produto |
| `docs/ROADMAP.md` | Plano 30 / 60 / 90 dias |

## 10. Fora de escopo (agora)

- Driver kernel / minifilter de produção
- Isolamento de rede em escala
- Paridade total com CrowdStrike Falcon
- Suporte multi-OS completo

3. Auditoria de logs brutos (SIEM)

Arquivo: `agent/config/coverage.yaml`

## Status (objetivo)

| Status | Significado |
|--------|-------------|
| `endpoint` | Detectável hoje pelo agente |
| `partial` | Sinal parcial no endpoint; rede completa o restante |
| `planned` | No escopo; falta sensor de rede / integração |
| `siem` | Via logs locais (`alerts` / `telemetry`) no console |

## Console

- Aba **Monitoramento** — os 3 pilares + detalhe por item  
- Aba **SIEM / Logs** — auditoria de `alerts.jsonl`, `telemetry.jsonl`, `service.log`

## Honestidade do protótipo

Não afirmamos IDS de rede completo. Itens como DGA, spam de saída e DNS reverso ficam `planned` até existir telemetria de rede.

# Eagle — Roadmap MVP (30 / 60 / 90 dias)

## Dia 0 (já entregue neste repositório)

- [x] Arquitetura de referência
- [x] Protótipo de agente Windows (telemetria + regras locais + resposta simulada)
- [x] Landing / pitch do produto

---

## 30 dias — Fundação operacional

**Objetivo:** agente estável em laboratório, alertas úteis, sem cloud obrigatória.

| Entrega | Detalhe |
|---------|---------|
| Instalador / serviço | Código Windows Service no repo (`eagle/service.py`); install **somente lab/VM** |
| Sensor contínuo | Loop de telemetria com baixa CPU; filtros por escopo |
| Pacote de regras v1 | ~30 regras (LOLBins, PS fileless, Office/browser chain, ransom, persistência) |
| Quarentena real | Move + ACL; allowlist de paths do sistema |
| Dashboard CLI | `eagle status`, `eagle alerts`, `eagle quarantine list` |
| Testes de regressão | Cenários sintéticos seguros (sem malware real) |
| Telemetria local | Export JSONL para SIEM (file beat / winlog opcional) |

**Critério de saída:** em VM de teste, detecta e age em ≥5 cenários comportamentais.

---

## 60 dias — Detecção moderna + memória

**Objetivo:** cobrir fileless e indicadores de memória; policies versionadas.

| Entrega | Detalhe |
|---------|---------|
| ETW (opcional) | Processo/imagem via Event Tracing for Windows |
| Memory scanner v1 | Heurísticas: RWX, pe unmapped, parent spoofing leve |
| Threat intel local | Feed de hashes/IPs em arquivo assinado ou HTTPS |
| Policy engine | YAML versionado; hot-reload sem reiniciar o serviço |
| ML leve (opcional) | Score offline em features de processo (treino em lab) |
| Exploit mitigation policy | Controles configuráveis (ex.: bloquear child shell de Office) |
| Pacote de evidências | Bundle para IR (timeline + hashes + árvore de processo) |

**Critério de saída:** playbook de ransomware e fileless com detecção + remediação documentada.

---

## 90 dias — Cloud leve + console mínima

**Objetivo:** gestão centralizada para poucos hosts (piloto).

| Entrega | Detalhe |
|---------|---------|
| Canal cloud | TLS mTLS ou token; telemetria + pull de policies |
| Console web mínima | Inventário, alertas, push de policy, quarantine remoto |
| Isolamento lógico | Corte de comunicação não-console (firewall API / policy) |
| Multi-tenant simples | Org → grupo → hosts |
| ATT&CK mapping | Tags MITRE nos alertas |
| Hardening do agente | Assinatura de updates; anti-tamper básico |
| Piloto | 5–20 endpoints Windows reais (consentidos) |

**Critério de saída:** piloto com SLA interno (ex.: alerta < 2 min; false positive documentado).

---

## Depois dos 90 dias (backlog)

- Linux agent
- Kernel / minifilter de arquivos
- Hunting advanced + correlação cross-host
- Modelo ML contínuo com feedback humano
- Certificações e avaliações (MITRE Engenuity, etc.)

## Riscos e mitigação

| Risco | Mitigação |
|-------|-----------|
| Falsos positivos | Modo monitor → enforce gradual; allowlists |
| Performance | Sampling, exclusões, orçamento de CPU/memória |
| Escopo “virar CrowdStrike” | Manter MVP comportamental + resposta; cloud só o necessário |
| Legal / lab | Só artefactos sintéticos; nunca malwares de produção em máquinas reais sem isolamento |
